searches.outcome: Confirmed the indexed Fitzpatrick node99 page but retained no evidential reliance on that URL; the full-text alternatives and local proofs cover the assigned claims.

alternatives.argument: The complete local proof in steps 1.1–4.1 derives the rational finite-sum transfer from the adopted oscillator ODE, locates every characteristic root and excludes upper-half-plane poles, constructs the retarded Green kernel separately in underdamped, critical and overdamped cases, verifies g,g′ and t g integrability for strictly positive damping, matches its normalized transfer to the causal-response supplier’s exact kernel hypotheses, computes the nonnegative real-frequency loss away from undamped poles, and states the Hilbert-transform result only in the integrable strictly damped branch. The proof does not use the failed node99 text as a premise.

The complete local proof in steps 1.1–2.1 applies the proved Lorentz energy formula to the two model states with P=0 and identical E,D,B,H. Positive definiteness and a>0 give zero oscillator storage for P_t=0 and |v|²/(2a)>0 for P_t=v≠0. The same pair therefore has equal instantaneous (E,D) but unequal stored energy; this argument uses the local postulate and theorem, not node99.
